title: Mit Luftdruckgewehr auf Passanten geschossen – Tatverdächtiger vorläufig festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 32-year-old man was hit in the stomach by an air rifle pellet on Falkenseer Damm in Spandau and suffered a superficial skin injury. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested in an apartment in Groenerstraße after a police search.
